steps.name: The Girl's Memories (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Dayna] in "Guild Union City Esnil", then defeat [Eda] in "Dreaming Oneiro" and obtain <Eda's Old Ribbon>. Report to [Shynic] in "Underground City Tartaros" afterward.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh, so much to do! Oh, %s... Weren't you resting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was resting at the inn, but something came to mind.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did you want to ask about my sister and me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it isn't about your sister.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Really? Thank you. Hehe. I hate attracting unnecessary attention.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then let me guess what's on your mind, %s... You're worried about that girl you met in Oneiro Forest!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Edda, was it? I saw her too. I went there on business once... The girl with the golem seemed perfectly ordinary.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But when you saw her, %s, she had something like a monster's arm growing out of her back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bergelmir said she was freed from her curse when she died. He also thanked me for helping someone named Shynic and destroying Ixion.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That must have happened in Eastland. Sorry, I don't know much about that. I do know you've been meeting Eastland's Champions, %s...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah, Shynic is one of the Champions, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should go.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: To see Shynic?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, I shouldn't go straight there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Good thinking. You'll want to visit Oneiro Forest first. The Alliance of Light and the Silvaria Empire's mages have purified it, so you should be all right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There might be evidence they overlooked. Have a look around.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You felt it last time, didn't you? Once you've been there, like you have, %s, it's easy to find again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's nothing... Just don't get overconfident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, then, Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Jelic, you're here?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: President, you're in! There's a new kind of bread, so I brought you some.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. Perfect timing. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Follow %s, just in case. Help if anything dangerous happens, and report back to me right away afterward.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I'll get going, then. Hmm... I need to bring some of this to Raclette too...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Raclette barely eats anyway. Just leave it all with me. Narsha and I will finish it. Now hurry along, all right?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Understood, Leader.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: On a boring day, when you need a friend... Maybe I should make myself a friend out of magic? Waaah, I'm bored...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, why not go for a short run?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Running is too much work! I hate getting sweaty!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I heard you used to enjoy running into Kali Village's barrier and bouncing off it. How about that?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, that is fun! But...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Medea would disapprove?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Of course. She must have been terribly annoyed over that business with %s last time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Huh? There's %s...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Should I give our friend a scare? Always such fun to tease... Melvic, pretend you haven't seen me. I'll hide over there.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course, Lady Shynic. I hope you enjoy yourself.
(Shynic hides behind a building, then leaps out in a catlike pose as %s approaches.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Rawr♡!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aah! You scared me! What's with the roaring?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You know that saying? Speak of the tiger, and it appears.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not a tiger, though.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Aww, what a boring reaction... (Should I kill you?) (Mumble, mumble.) Looks like you came for a reason... What is it? Anything interesting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I could swear I just heard something dangerous... Anyway, look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You hand Shynic the old ribbon you found in Oneiro Forest.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's this...?
(Shynic takes the ribbon and falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No, it couldn't be... Just a coincidence. This ribbon...
(Shynic unties the ribbon in her hair and compares it with the one in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: To my dear Shynic... To my dear Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, where did you get this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Shynic about the girl named Edda you saw in Oneiro Forest, and explain what happened.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Edda...? Did you say Edda?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...Edda, Edda... Edda...
(Repeating Edda's name, Shynic sinks to the ground. Something is wrong. She seems to be panicking...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic!! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ugh... Ugh... I-I'm fine...
(Shynic loses consciousness and collapses. A startled Melvic gathers her into his arms and hurries to her room.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could have happened to make her react like that...?
(A little later, Melvic returns to %s, looking deeply worried.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic has stabilized for now, but...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think memories of the past are distressing her. Memories that torment her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... What should we do?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, may I ask a favor? Could you explain the situation to Lady Medea and ask for her help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. This seems to be my fault. I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you. I'll stay here and watch over Lady Shynic.

steps.name: The Girl's Memories (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] in the "Divine Tree Lapier" and obtain a <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Medea] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you. I sensed a change in the winds blowing toward Tartaros... Is this about Shynic?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much do you know, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I merely sense these things. Don't worry about how. Tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what happened to Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know she would react that way. I never imagined the girl in Oneiro Forest would have something like that...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is something you misunderstand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We are human. We simply possess powers a little different from those of ordinary people. Yes, those powers... They are both a blessing and a curse.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Believing imperfect beings to be perfect... That is a mistake ordinary people make, yourself included.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You needn't apologize to me. It is simply a human weakness. Explain things to Shynic when she wakes.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For now, I will make some medicine that should help her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah... I don't have the ingredients.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get them. Where should I look?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Very well. Bring me a Seed of Illusion from Lapier. It is different from the Illusion Tree Seeds the Tractus carry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The ingredient rarely appears, so it may be difficult to find... But I believe you can manage.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, you've seen another side of the world since we last met. It is a place people cannot ordinarily enter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes... It just happened...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That must be your path.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find it as quickly as I can. Please wait for me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Very well...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're back. How was Lapier?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Much the same as before. I didn't sense anything ominous.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: May I have the ingredient?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It has been a long time since I last used this ingredient to make medicine. That time, it was for the boy who stayed by Shynic's side...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please wait a moment. It won't take long. I'll pour you some tea while you wait. Here...
(Medea gives you some tea, then turns her attention to making the medicine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the tea you served last time. I remember its lovely fragrance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad you like it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There, it's ready. Have Shynic drink this. Her condition won't kill her, of course...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No, it couldn't kill her. But this should help calm her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait a moment...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is there nothing you wish to ask me? It seems you have met Weiss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I, too, possess power needed by the god you serve, but you seem hesitant...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if I want it, I don't think now is the time. You told me to visit often so you could learn to trust me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go now. You are welcome here, so I shall expect another visit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll see you again, Medea.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea, I saw someone following %s after the adventurer left. I wasn't sure what was happening, so I thought I should report it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You needn't concern yourself with that, Beinan. They are fulfilling their own duty.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Understood. If you say so, Lady Medea. They did leave all these boxes behind, though. They seem to contain food...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come to think of it, your manner of speaking has changed thanks to %s, Beinan. For the better, of course.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, this is... cake. I haven't seen one in a while. There's a card, too...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: "Happy birthday, Lady Medea. —The Mongle Mongle Guild"

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How did they know my birthday...? Ah, that person on the other continent would know.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea, how many candles should I put on it? I imagine we'll need quite a lot...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I take back the compliment. You really have no tact...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Ah! My apologies.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right. Go and invite the villagers instead. Good food should be shared.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Of course. I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic... Please get through this.

steps.name: The Girl's Memories (5)
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvic] in "Underground City Tartaros", then find [Shynic].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, you're back. I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Shynic all right?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: She's a little calmer now, but I'm still worried. That ribbon seems to have touched something deep inside her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought medicine Medea made for her. Here...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you. I'll give Lady Shynic the medicine...
(Melvic gives Shynic the medicine. Color returns to her previously listless face.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ahh! I nearly died!!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What? Worried I might actually have died?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If she's making jokes like that, she must be fine...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Shynic that you explained the situation to Medea and brought back medicine.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's the medicine I gave Melvic to save his life. It works on me too?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Ah, so that was the same medicine, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, exactly. What was she thinking, sending it over? What if I'd taken decades to wake up, like you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I will always be grateful to you for making it possible for me to be here...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Enough. I didn't save you to hear you thank me. Anyway, I'll have to visit Medea sometime and thank her♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, I'm fine. Perfectly fine. Where's the ribbon? Ah, here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I have to be. Now I'll tell you my story, %s... Want to listen too, Melvic?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'll leave you to it. I need to speak with Noel about some trading company business.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right. Come with me, then, %s. I'll tell you what you want to know back at my place♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's probably just what you've guessed... Shall I begin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There was a tiny village in a corner of the desert kingdom of Jude. Latins Village. That was my home.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Deimos cult attacked as it expanded its reach, but a mage fought them off, and thankfully the village escaped serious damage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That mage was...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion. The man I cursed and hated so much.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion, the great mage of the Kingdom of Jude. To us children, he was a hero. We followed him and dreamed of becoming mages.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: He lured us in by promising we could become mages too. He told our parents he would take us away and train us into great mages, and they agreed.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Edda and I were among those children. We all believed we'd become mages of the Kingdom of Jude. I'm certain of it... But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to tell me if it's too painful.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's fine. Just listen. Where was I...? Ah, the children followed Ixion to Moros and began studying magic in a place called the shelter.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But something was wrong. They injected us with some kind of power, but we never questioned it. It all seemed as wondrous as magic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It was fun being with our friends, and we believed we could protect people by defeating the Deimos cult's fanatics with that magic in the Dark War.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: We thought that was all there was to it. Only later did we realize something was wrong.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They kept pouring that strange power into us. Children who couldn't endure it began growing strange things from their bodies. They were no longer human...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That didn't happen to me, but I had side effects too. I stopped growing. I couldn't die...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I had to go to war and kill people with no control over myself...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Whenever I came to, there was a weapon drenched in the blood of thousands, tens of thousands. That's when I understood. I could never be the person I'd been before.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Still, I thought it would stop when the Dark War ended. But then Ixion began disposing of the children who were no longer useful...
(Shynic's eyes waver.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought we could go home when the war ended... When Ixion briefly loosened his binding, I escaped with the other children...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But that power of his caught us again and drove us berserk. In that moment, I realized it would only end if I killed Ixion...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But I couldn't think clearly then. I had to survive. I thought I was the only one who made it out... But Edda was alive...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Edda loved flowers and trees. She was always making decorations with them. She liked making clothes, too...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If only I'd known... If only I'd looked a little sooner... If I'd only gone a little earlier.
(Tears gather in Shynic's eyes and begin to fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. Now listen to the rest. I'll keep talking even if you don't want to hear it♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought everything would be over if I went home, but while the war kept me away, my home disappeared.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Still, that's how I came to build this wonderful city, catch the people who come to kill me, and throw them into the Abyss Chamber... I even locked Ixion up here when he came for me...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You were the one who finished him off, but it's all right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why the long face? I'm fine. Whew. I haven't told anyone this since Melvic and Medea.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Even if I feel like killing you from now on, I won't♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll tell you one more thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's more?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wasn't going to tell you, but... Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Want to know? Then keep bringing me interesting things until I can trust you♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, that doesn't sound like Shynic's line...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Now I could die without regrets♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, please don't make jokes like that. Seriously...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right, all right. I won't. Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go now. Get some rest today.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll have to make one more gravestone... Welcome home, Edda... The home you wanted to return to so badly... Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah... Why didn't I realize?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...It was the power of binding that did this to Edda and me...
